purpose: Unfilled teacher-only prerequisites for original spoken narrative tasks005,009,018; not evidence of delivery or review.
steps: Before use a qualified CRS teacher checks passage accuracy, age/class suitability, local wording and the original rubric; agree an appropriate live/recorded speech and accessibility route. No fixed speed or compulsory Bible translation is invented.
For005 and009 hear an individual coherent oral narrative. A written plan alone is not sufficient. Do not require personal religious experiences or judge a child’s spiritual status.

For018 the teacher narrates the selected Samuel episode and speaks Eli’s guidance; the learner speaks Samuel’s responses and explains the change. Keep it an educational role, not a claim of an actual divine call to the pupil.
Use narration/spoken roles only. Do not physically enact wrestling, injury, restraint, arrest or crucifixion. Source drama/video/group requirements remain broader than these three narrow oral tasks.
Assess actual individual speech against criteria; any local recording/evidence retention follows school policy. No pupil name, recording or fabricated performance result is stored in this protocol.
